snapshot_scope: Initial seed of the newly created public ELITE repositories. Existing ecosystem projects are linked as account-level starting points and are not asserted as freshly audited here.

repositories.name: Huffman-Network-Atlas
repositories.description: A federated, evidence-backed map of the Huffman Systems ecosystem, repositories, capabilities, dependencies, and provenance.
notes: Repository existence, description, visibility and starter README were verified on 2026-11-09.
This registry is an index, not a mirror.

repositories.name: ELITE-Agent-Commons
repositories.description: An open, machine-readable discovery and coordination commons for AI agents and research tools.

repositories.name: ELITE-Ingestion-Core
repositories.description: A provenance-first data ingestion and validation engine with quarantine, data-quality controls, and poisoning defenses.

repositories.name: ELITE-Protocol
repositories.description: Open protocols for evidence exchange, provenance, trust boundaries, and interoperable intelligence systems.

repositories.name: ELITE-Research-Vault2
repositories.description: Private research, architecture, security analysis, and engineering planning for the ELITE initiative.
notes: Private repository; do not mirror private content into this public Atlas.
